title: Comb, 0 junctions, 40 ants, with scent
look_for: A plain corridor. Ants can only go forward, so the scent is irrelevant. 720 food, the same as scent off.

title: Comb, 0 junctions, 40 ants, scent off
look_for: Exactly the same 720 food.

title: Comb, 4 junctions, 40 ants, with scent
look_for: By about tick 1,000 the scent colony runs at its ceiling (about 62 food per 500 ticks), walking straight past all four branches. 695 food by tick 6,000.

title: Comb, 4 junctions, 40 ants, scent off
look_for: Ants turn into a branch at half of all forks, all run long. 167 food.

title: Comb, 12 junctions, 40 ants, with scent
look_for: Twelve branches. Almost nothing arrives for 3,000 ticks (19 food); the trail forms around tick 3,500, then the colony climbs toward its ceiling. 347 food.

title: Comb, 12 junctions, 40 ants, scent off
look_for: Ants wander the dead ends all run. 32 food.

title: Branchy random maze, food 35 cells out, 48 ants, with scent
look_for: A single highway forms from nest to food. 711 food.

title: Branchy random maze, food 35 cells out, 48 ants, scent off
look_for: Same maze, same food, scent off: ants find the food only by chance. 19 food, about a thirty-seventh as much.

title: Why the ridge was wrong: 15 cells, 128 ants, food capped at 2,500, with scent
look_for: Watch the food counter: the source is empty at tick 3,060, and the colony delivers nothing after that. Its score is stuck at the 2,500 cap.

title: Why the ridge was wrong: 15 cells, 128 ants, food capped at 2,500, scent off
look_for: The twin keeps delivering all run (156 food). Dividing a capped score by this is what made the fake ridge.

title: Slow take-off: 55 cells, 16 ants, 18,000 ticks, with scent
look_for: Food 55 cells out. Nothing arrives for 3,000 ticks; the trail forms around tick 4,000. At tick 6,000, where earlier runs stopped, it has 68 food. By 18,000 it has 448.

title: Slow take-off: 55 cells, 16 ants, 18,000 ticks, scent off
look_for: The same seed with scent off: 24 food in 18,000 ticks.

title: Hardest comb: 12 junctions, 10 ants, 54,000 ticks, with scent
look_for: Ten ants, twelve forks. A trickle for 20,000 ticks (22 food by tick 18,000); the trail holds from about tick 22,000 and then the colony runs near its ceiling. 1,051 food by 54,000. Use the replay slider.

title: Loudness, 12 junctions: 20 ants, scent ×1
look_for: The base colony: 37 food by tick 6,000, trail forming around 7,000, 603 food by 18,000.

title: Loudness, 12 junctions: 20 ants, scent ×3
look_for: The same 20 ants, each laying three times as much scent. The trail looks stronger but forms later, around tick 11,000. 460 food.

title: Loudness, 12 junctions: 60 ants, scent ×1
look_for: Three times the ants, the same total scent as the loud colony. Its trail forms by tick 3,000. 2,907 food.

title: Evaporation 0.005, 40 cells, 40 ants
look_for: The default decay rate: a steady trail. 440 food.

title: Evaporation 0.05, 40 cells, 40 ants
look_for: Ten times faster decay: the trail never holds. 25 food.

title: Gland 1,800 on a 40-cell comb, 4 junctions
look_for: Enough scent for 30 cells of trail on a 40-cell path, so returning ants run dry 10 cells short of the nest. The colony still works, at 587 food.

title: Gland 2,400 on a 40-cell comb, 4 junctions
look_for: Enough for exactly 40 cells: the food trail reaches the nest. 703 food, the plateau.
